data_source.warning: Availability and delays depend on the upstream source; missing values are never imputed as observed facts.

execution_assumptions.rule: A signal is resolved HIT only when its directional return remains positive after the estimated round-trip cost.

model_learning.note: Errori verificati possono ridurre presto il peso; premi positivi richiedono campioni molto più maturi. Probabilità e learning sono segmentati anche per orizzonte: esiti a 3 giorni non vengono trattati come prova per 20 giorni.

known_limitations: Current-universe survivorship bias is not removed in the lightweight backtest.
No fundamentals, analyst estimates, order book, options IV surface, or official bond YTM are fabricated when absent.
Daily bars cannot determine intraday event order when stop and target are both touched in the same session.
Adaptive horizon selection is conditional on the current daily setup family and historical daily bars; it is not a guarantee that the selected holding window will outperform alternatives.
